items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: Joe Glazier, who was Roy's manager, comes in and saw me sitting up there and he said, 'Where's Sid Catlett?'

ctx.x: Well, while we're at rehearsal, Joe Glazier, who was Roy's manager, comes in and saw me sitting up there and he said, "Where's Sid Catlett?" So Roy said "Well, this is my drummer here." And that's one reason why I have a lot of respect and a warm spot in my heart for Roy, because he stood up for me with Joe Glazier. When Joe Glazier said, "Well, look, I want Big Sid in this band."
He wanted Big Sid in the band, huh?
